uz: Turbina qismida esa teskari jarayon: issiq gaz kengayib, pichoqlarga urilib ularni aylantiradi. Bosim va harorat bosqichma-bosqich tushadi.
en: In the turbine section the reverse happens: hot gas expands, striking the blades to spin them. Pressure and temperature drop stage by stage.

uz: AChR (avtomatik chastotali yuklamani tushirish) chastota pasayganda bir qism iste'molchini avtomatik uzadi — bu qolgan tizimni to'liq qulashdan saqlaydi.
en: Automatic frequency load shedding disconnects some consumers when frequency drops — saving the rest of the system from total collapse.
